+## Original adaptive construction: Source
+
+For natural a,b,s, put k=a+b+2s and A=1+2^a+2^(a+b)+2^(a+b+s). The physical chains U,V,W,X start at 0,s,2s,2s+b and have lengths s,s,b,a. The enlarged heads are 2A, Bn=2B-1, Ln=2L-z-1 and Mn=2M-D; its modulus is Q=2N+1.
+
+The recurrences are zA=N+B, zB=N+L, yL=N+M, xM=N+A, and z(2A)=Q+Bn, zBn=Q+Ln, yLn=Q+Mn, xMn=Q+A. With a,b,s at least 2, each nonterminal occurrence is its head times its local power of two and is positive; every terminal is negative, with doubled value equal to successor minus modulus. These facts specialize the existing physical centered-source arithmetic to the equal-tail layout.
+

These are the exact row formulas consumed by both schedules. Source preparation alone does not choose a permutation or prove the full Circle J statement.

+## Original adaptive construction: Native
+
+Assume s>=2 and either 2s+2<=a with a+1<=b, or s+1<=a with max(a+1,3s+1)<=b. These premises imply a>=s+1, b>=a+1 and b>=2s. With x=2^a,y=2^b,z=2^s, set lambda=2^(b-a-1), epsilon=0 for b=a+1 and epsilon=2^(b-a-2) otherwise. The W allocation is p=y/(2z)+y/z^2-1-epsilon. Its nested capacities are H=2^(b-s)-1 and F=2^(b-1)-1.
+
+The adaptive X allocation is C=2^(a-s-1)-delta, where delta=1 when b>=3s+1 and delta=0 otherwise; its capacity is E=2^(a-1)-1. Exact power factorizations justify the natural quotients and integer casts, including every subtraction. The bounds are 0<=p<=H<=F and 0<=C<=E. Only the capacities H,F,E are required to be all-ones masks: C may be an arbitrary submask of E when delta=0, and C=0 is allowed.
+
+The bitwise complement identities become H XOR p=H-p, F XOR H=F-H and E XOR C=E-C, with safe integer casts. The low-bit bound ensures every decoded set bit is a legal local positive position. These facts support a partition of physical occurrences, without replacing the masks by merely equal numerical masses.
